summary.title: Summary
summary.text: Infrastructure Specialist with 4 years of experience in cloud-native infrastructure and DevOps practices. Currently responsible for migrating and operating critical DevOps toolchains on Kubernetes in OVH Cloud. Focus areas include Infrastructure as Code, GitOps workflows, and implementing scalable database solutions across multiple clusters. Quick comprehension of complex technical concepts and strong team orientation through knowledge sharing and pair programming. Hands-on mentality with focus on automation, reliability, and pragmatic solutions.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Specialist
responsibilities: Migration and operation of critical DevOps toolchain from on-premises to Kubernetes in OVH Cloud with minimal downtime for CI/CD, issue tracking, and collaboration tools
Design and rollout of highly available PostgreSQL infrastructure with CloudNativePG across 20 Kubernetes clusters, including automated backup, point-in-time recovery, and comprehensive monitoring
Redesign of cluster architecture with 2 dedicated infrastructure nodes for platform tools (Istio, ArgoCD) to separate platform and application workloads

Implementation and management of cluster-wide service mesh with Istio for advanced traffic management, security, and observability using VirtualServices, Gateways, PeerAuthentication, and DestinationRules

Standardization of multi-cluster deployments through ArgoCD ApplicationSets (Istio) and App-of-Apps pattern (CNPG, Monitoring) for improved maintainability, scalability, and clarity across 20 clusters
Implementation of cluster-wide backup strategy with Velero and S3 storage to ensure business continuity
Maintenance and operation of central monitoring and observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Kiali) for entire infrastructure
Implementation of security best practices through Sealed Secrets for secret management and Kyverno policies for role-based access control at namespace level
Management of central container registry and artifact repository for enterprise-wide image and package management

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
responsibilities: Development and operation of CI/CD pipelines for automating build, test, and deployment processes for development teams
Automation of cloud infrastructure provisioning with Terraform on AWS for consistent, versioned, and reproducible environments
Management and automation of lifecycle management for over 200 Linux servers using Ansible for updates, upgrades, and configuration changes
Setup and management of Proxmox virtualization platform for server and container workloads to optimize resource utilization
Implementation and operation of enterprise-wide monitoring system with Zabbix for all Linux systems for proactive error identification

jobs.title: Junior DevOps Engineer
responsibilities: Support and development of backend infrastructure for a Product Information Management (PIM) system using Python and Bash automation
Monitoring and incident management of production environment with Nagios to ensure high availability
Technical support for customers with integration and configuration of the PIM system

items.name: HomeLab
items.description: Self-hosted Kubernetes cluster on Proxmox with complete GitOps workflow via ArgoCD. Deployment and management of enterprise tools including Istio Service Mesh, Harbor Container Registry, CloudNativePG Database Operator, Kyverno Policy Engine, Sealed Secrets, Prometheus/Grafana/Kiali Monitoring, Elastic/Kibana Logging, and Traefik Ingress Controller. Continuous exploration of new cloud-native technologies and concepts in a production-like environment.

items.name: RSS Feed Checker and Telegram Notifier
items.description: Containerized Python application for automated RSS feed monitoring with Telegram notifications. Deployed on Hetzner Cloud with GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline for automated updates.

items.description: Portfolio website with automated deployment on GitHub Pages via CI/CD pipeline.
